name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: A toolkit that makes AI coding assistants like Claude Code work better and more reliably — more of a tune-up kit for developers than something a non-coder would ever touch.
buyer: A software engineer or engineering manager already using AI coding assistants daily who wants fewer mistakes and wasted tokens from their agent.
business_use_cases: An engineering team installs it org-wide to standardize how their AI coding agents handle memory and security across projects.
A dev-tools consultant offers 'AI coding agent audits' for companies, using it as part of the toolkit to speed up agents.
A platform team builds internal guardrails on top of its security module before letting AI agents touch production code.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid setup and tuning consulting for engineering teams adopting AI coding agents at scale.

steal_this: There's little standalone business here for a non-developer — it's a dev-productivity tool, not a product to resell.
